name: trust-tasks-example-hcp-demo-ts
description: A demonstration of the Human Context Protocol (HCP) carried as Trust Tasks: discovery, grant request held with a next step, query, revoke and revocation notice between a toy in-memory HCP provider, a Context Client and a Management Client, sealed over TSP and signed with Data Integrity proofs. Not a reference provider.

scripts.all: npm run generate && npm run build && npm start && npm test
